digest.component_or_area: deployed Gerrit review bot / project.review-phase-boundaries criterion
propositions: Run an advisory-only Gerrit dogfood probe to prove end-to-end execution of a project-loaded review criterion through the deployed bot's webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt pipeline.

Use four sequential patchsets on one Gerrit change: a valid positive-control refinement, an unchanged historical severity-only directive, the predeclared RP-F2 FIRE control, and a final cleaned revision submitted to main.

The RP-F2 FIRE control must produce a project-attributed advisory finding carrying reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria project.review-phase-boundaries, with recorded Pass-2 validity/impact and Pass-3 priority/decision.
Keep blocking_enabled false and block_threshold 0.90 throughout; the probe is observational and does not change the rubric or enable blocking.
Record operator-attested evidence (remote URL, change id, patchset SHA, UTC timestamp, bot vote/message, artifact payload) for the precondition and each patchset.
Post a calibration handoff comment with labels 'Priority distribution:' and 'Blocking promotion: deferred' naming a separate data-backed posture ticket as the only route to enabling blocking.
